Method of Attack: Injects itself in the native Google Play Store app process
Steals and mimics the device's unique ID, the phone owner's Google account, and internal authorization codes
Performs operations such as searching the catalog, requesting and confirming purchases, accepting license terms, downloading APK files, managing reviews, and confirming program downloads
Downloads apps from the Play Store and saves them to a local SD card before installing them
Boosts install counts of other apps
Attack Vector: Second-stage download on phones infected by Android.DownLoader trojans
Infiltration of the local Play Store Android app process
